narrative.title: Uptime Streak in the Sensor Bitmap
narrative.scenario: A health monitor records one bit per minute, where 1 means the node was reachable and 0 means it dropped. The reliability report needs the longest uninterrupted uptime streak in that bitmap. Report the length of the longest run of ones.
narrative.inputFormat: An array nums of n binary values (only 0 and 1).
narrative.outputFormat: The length of the longest contiguous run of 1s, or 0 when no minute was healthy.

testCases.explanation: The final three minutes form the longest healthy run, beating the opening pair.
Healthy minutes are split by drops, and the best run is the middle pair of length 2.

hintLevels: Level 1: One pass is enough - keep a streak counter that grows on healthy minutes and a best-so-far value.
Level 2: Reset the streak to zero whenever a drop appears, and update the best after each healthy minute.
Level 3: An all-drop bitmap must report 0, and the best value has to be refreshed even when the run ends at the final minute.
